name: brainiac
description: Plugins for Brainiac, a local second brain kept as plain Markdown: daily-use skills (brainiac-kernel), optional maintenance skills (brainiac-extras) and the installer (brainiac-manager).

plugins.name: brainiac-kernel
plugins.description: Daily-use skills for a Brainiac vault: search, capture, curate, promote and style-check notes in a local Markdown second brain.

plugins.name: brainiac-extras
plugins.description: Optional maintenance skills for a Brainiac vault: curation lint, session retrospectives, scheduled-task registration and retrieval self-tuning.

plugins.name: brainiac-manager
plugins.description: Installs, updates, checks and removes the Brainiac engine on your machine, and stages a Cowork workspace for your vault.
